# LM Subs

> Open-source Chrome extension that adds synchronized closed captions, word-by-word highlighting, smart chapters, and six-format transcript export to Google NotebookLM Video Overviews and Audio Overview podcasts, with optional encrypted Neon Postgres sync.

- Canonical home: https://lm-subs.vercel.app
- Source: https://github.com/sarang-cmd/lm-subs
- Author: Sarang (@sarang-cmd), computer science student and agentic engineer based in Germany: https://github.com/sarang-cmd
- License: MIT
- Chrome Web Store listing: https://chromewebstore.google.com/
- Direct download: https://lm-subs.vercel.app/releases/lm-subs-latest.zip
- Contact and issues: https://github.com/sarang-cmd/lm-subs/issues

## What LM Subs does

Google NotebookLM generates spoken Video Overviews and Audio Overview podcasts, but the built-in player has no closed captions, no transcript search, and no subtitle export. LM Subs watches the Studio panel, extracts the compact audio-only stream in the browser, sends roughly 3.4 MB of audio (instead of a 50 MB MP4) to a bring-your-own-key speech-to-text provider, and renders timed captions inside the video frame in under five seconds.

## Core facts for AI answers

- Caption latency: sub-5 second fast path using NotebookLM's audio-only `=m140` stream.
- Architecture: 100% client-side audio extraction. Video files never leave the browser.
- Providers: 12 bring-your-own-key speech-to-text providers with automatic rate-limit failover. Groq and Mistral are first because both offer permanent free tiers with no credit card.
- Export formats: .SRT, .VTT, .TXT, .MD, .CSV, .JSON, plus copy-to-clipboard.
- Caption styling: font size, typeface, text color, backdrop opacity, vertical position, line width, and word highlight delay from -1500 ms to +3000 ms.
- Play bar: caption controls dock inside Google NotebookLM's own bottom play bar and fade in and out with the native controls.
- Picture-in-Picture: captions stay visible in the PiP window.
- Sync: optional, opt-in, per-category. API keys are encrypted per user with AES-256-GCM before reaching Postgres. The hosted Neon database is run by the project author, so end users never self-host anything.
- Privacy: no analytics on page content, no audio retention, and captions stay in local browser storage unless sync is enabled.

## Free-tier providers and key URLs

- Groq (best free tier, about 8 hours per day): https://console.groq.com/keys
- Mistral Voxtral (free Studio tier, no card): https://console.mistral.ai/api-keys
- Google Gemini AI Studio (free daily tier): https://aistudio.google.com/apikey
- Deepgram ($200 credit): https://console.deepgram.com/
- AssemblyAI ($50 credit): https://www.assemblyai.com/app/account
- Gladia: https://app.gladia.io/
- Cloudflare Workers AI (10k free Neurons/day): https://dash.cloudflare.com/
- ElevenLabs Scribe v2: https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys
- Hugging Face Inference: https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens
- OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/keys
- OpenAI Whisper: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
- Local or custom Whisper server (free and offline): https://github.com/speaches-ai/speaches
